final_checkpoint_selection: Fixed final step300; no favorable intermediate selection.
objective: Maximize J_theta - eta0*C_theta, normalized by baseline expected query cost. J is signed actual-MH potential decrease, C is importance-estimated scored-proposal raw cost. eta0 is the frozen FIT baseline J/C. Add an empirical forward/reverse log-ratio penalty; it is not a KL claim. Learned action variants use FULL forward/reverse action-plus-coordinate densities and FULL uniform-action behavioral density, with separate action_log_ratio=0.
edge_sampling: Half parent/replica/condition-balanced empirical weights, half the same weights times absolute baseline cost-adjusted utility. Divide every minibatch contribution by its exact index sampling probability. No scored/accepted-only conditioning.
validation: All12 newly hashed selection parents; report every condition, raw J, C, J/C, constitutional flow, scored-edge ESS and weight range. These remain internal empirical proxies, not molecular efficiency or final evaluation.
scope: Three bounded offline variants, two seeds each; no new physical queries. No fitting on fresh proposal outcomes, prior molecular evaluations or reserved conditions. Internal comparisons are descriptive and not multiplicity-adjusted. Fresh measured sampling gains remain necessary.
initialization: Physical site coordinates and uniform legal actions exactly. Geometry constructed first; geometry-only uses the same seeds/configuration as the prior two-seed geometric utility comparison.
move_family_schedule: Fixed externally; no local/rotation/joint frequency learned.
ablations: Same fixed steps, minibatch draws, seed pairs, data, objective coefficients and total log-ratio bound. Report active parameter counts and runtime; total neural parameter counts are not matched.
audit: Rebuild split, replay every final/baseline edge, independently evaluate action probabilities and arc densities on one scored edge per parent, check trained objective finite differences for both active heads. No optimizer-trajectory replay claim.
